subject: orca
title: Orcas Flip the Biggest Fish on Earth Upside Down, Then Bite

scenes.text: The biggest fish on Earth has one weak spot. Orcas found it.
Whale sharks grow to eighteen meters. One orca pod off Mexico hunts them anyway.
Scientists caught it four times in six years. One big male was there for three.
First, the orcas ram the shark and flip it upside down.
Upside down, sharks go limp. Then the orcas bite the belly, where it's softest.
They're after the fat-rich liver. The weak spot was always underneath.

description:
Whale sharks, the biggest fish on Earth, have a weak spot, and one orca pod in the Gulf of California has learned it.
Between 2018 and 2024, scientists documented four hunts. The orcas ram a young whale shark, flip it upside down so it goes limp, then attack the softer belly and pelvic area to reach the fat-rich liver. One adult male, Moctezuma, took part in three of the hunts.
Which animal would you bet on in a fight?
first_comment: One adult male, nicknamed Moctezuma, took part in three of the four hunts, so this may be a skill passed around one family. Who wins: the biggest fish or the smartest hunter?
